item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? It's the Mid-Autumn Festival. Look for the big round moon tonight! Here is your weather report for Friday, September 25. Friday at last. One more day and it's the weekend. Here in Shanghai, the day will be a little bit rainy. Temperatures will go up to 33 degrees, with a low of 24. It's going to be a real scorcher. The chance of rain is 60 percent. Here's something to notice: today is about 3 degrees warmer than yesterday. Do you think you can feel it? Don't forget your umbrella today! As for tomorrow, expect it to be thundery, with a high of 33 degrees. What would you tell a friend about harvest? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
